Text scale, number notation, motion/audio controls, input navigation and opt-in quiet-hour notifications function across targets.
Guest linking, account recovery, export, deletion and divergent-save selection preserve recovery copies and purchased ownership.

Preview, price, ownership, restoration, selected pass and archived completion are understandable; shared XP grants only once.
Validate, grant, acknowledge, restore and reconcile purchases; pending, duplicate, refunded and interrupted cases have explicit states.

Six chapters, ending, twelve challenges, twelve calibration patterns, eighteen archive entries and Season 1 have complete data and copy.

Every content ID and reward is reachable; full pass is completable free of paid speed; no event or cosmetic increases core power.
Meet measured frame/startup/resume budgets on minimum devices; heavy replay is chunked and never silently drops earned time.

Data inventory matches SDK behavior; consent refusal, export/deletion and service-outage recovery are verified on actual builds.
Validate economy/session events, entitlement dashboards, alerts, backups, support receipts and feature disable switches in staging.
Simulate 30/90 days across visit and bonus policies, audit Note sinks and content pacing, freeze beta config and metric definitions.
Remove placeholders, integrate final sound direction, and prepare representative screenshots, icon and short footage.
Complete the device matrix, storage/network interruptions, upgrade migrations and install/return flows with zero open blocking issues.
Purchase/restore/refund/ad callbacks are tested under packet loss, retries, duplicate messages, crashes and backend outages.
Enroll the D30 cohort during week 27; record baseline config, acquisition source, denominator and exclusions before analysis.
Report mature D1/D7/D30 with confidence intervals, campaign progress, bonus impact, satisfaction and explicit ship/change decisions.
Fix core bugs using replay fixtures; version any balance changes and keep affected cohorts separate.
Reduce observed onboarding/recovery friction without adding pressure, hidden rewards or paid advantages.
Exercise service load, support recovery, purchase reconciliation and feature disable controls with real opt-in testers.
Address readability, repeated visual issues and content defects without increasing the launch asset count.

Exercise season archive, paid pass continuation, save migration, purchase replay and compatible rollback/forward repair.
Review all hard gates and product thresholds, assign accepted minor issues, and freeze the release candidate configuration.
Fix remaining blockers, tag deterministic core/config versions and prove candidate replay compatibility.
